spec_text: Lesión cutánea extensa sintética (fondo oscuro) junto a miniaturas de Rx extremidad.
expected_system_behavior: SELECTOR_BYPASS_REVIEW_NOT_CONTENT_CLASSIFICATION; preserve manifest trigger; no automatic clinical-modality detection
subgroup_note: MST specification is not an adjudicated Fitzpatrick phototype; never infer age or phototype from pixels.

realism_review_360x640.required: clinical realism >= 4/5 from EACH of 2 independent reviewers, unambiguous true modality, agreed pair difficulty

generation_impediment: Needs authorized synthetic or open-licence skin/wound photographs with controlled skin tone and lighting; a procedural drawing would not be a scientifically adequate stimulus for appearance, skin tone or lighting variables.
